src: each foreground color's pair of same-height vertical bars sharing one row interval
path: from each bar, continue upward and downward in row blocks of the bar height; the left bar shifts one column left per block and the right bar shifts one column right per block, clipping at the grid edge
trajectory: paint every in-bounds emitted pixel with the bar pair's color
transform: cells claimed by two or more different colors become pink; all unclaimed cells remain background
